Chapter 624: Chapter 43 Mysterious Emperor Lineage (Please Subscribe)

“`

Outside the palace.

Lin Yuan was carefully observing; this towering structure spanned many spatial layers and was extraordinarily inconceivable.

“According to human civilization’s intelligence on the Xuanhuang Secret Realm’s core area, past openings of the secret realm did not reveal a palace like this, did they?”

Lin Yuan pondered to himself.

There was none before.

...

Now it suddenly appeared?

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but suspect it was related to him.

The feeling of being called that he perceived originated from deep within this palace.

Boom.

Just then.

The entrance to the palace, the originally closed doors, suddenly began to open slowly.

“Hm?”

“The doors are opening?”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew solemn. If before he merely suspected the palace’s appearance was because of him, now he was almost certain of it.

Earlier, a few special Ninth Rank individuals wandered outside the palace for a good while but did not enter; now, shortly after he waited outside, the gates opened on their own?

“Be that as it may.”

“Let’s go in and take a look.”

After pondering for a moment, Lin Yuan made up his mind.

For him, the worst-case scenario was the loss of this one Primordial Spirit.

As for affecting his true self, with the Soul-Settling Pearl bestowed by the Xia Qin Supreme Being, even if a Twelfth Stage Powerhouse wanted to kill Lin Yuan outright, they wouldn’t be able to.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm has a mysterious origin, and even ultimate beings can’t pinpoint its coordinates, but that doesn’t mean it’s more frightening than a Supreme Being.

If Stone Statue Shen Ji was correct, the “Emperor” of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm had been missing for eons and was nearly forgotten even during the Moyu Tower Master’s era.

How much power could possibly remain now?

However, before entering the palace.

Lin Yuan took out a drop of his blood essence and put all the treasures he had gained in the realm inside a space bracelet.

Then he sent both items deep into the numerous spatial layers.

In this way, even if an extreme circumstance occurred and this Lin Yuan’s Primordial Spirit perished within the palace,

that drop of blood essence could swiftly “blood rebirth,” taking the gains inside the space bracelet and leaving the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

It would not have been a wasted journey.

“Let’s go in.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and stepped into the palace.

As soon as Lin Yuan fully entered, the gates that had opened slowly closed,

and the towering palace began to dematerialize rapidly, eventually vanishing from its place.

If the few special Ninth Rank individuals who had fled earlier were to return, they would find that the mysterious palace had completely disappeared.

As if it had never existed at all.

However, considering the prestige of the Galaxy Master, even if those special Ninth Rank individuals had the gall, they wouldn’t dare to approach the spot where Lin Yuan had been.

…

Lin Yuan walked into the palace.

Faintly, he sensed subtle spatial fluctuations and couldn’t help thinking: “I must be far from the main spatial layer of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm by now, but I have no idea which layer I am in.”

In the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the number of spatial layers far exceeds the World of Gods, with at least over two billion layers, Lin Yuan, unable to see an end.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan looked around. He was in a vast plain, silently serene, and at the center of the plain, there was also a palace situated.

Similar to the one outside, but the aura was much more tranquil.

“Xuan Huang Hall?”

Lin Yuan noticed the three complex characters inscribed on the surface of the palace pillars.

Although it wasn’t any script Lin Yuan had encountered, it was like the essence of the Great Dao, and he could understand its meaning at a glance.

“Indeed, it’s the Mysterious Emperor Lineage.”

Lin Yuan was somewhat reassured; Stone Statue Shen Ji had told him a bit about the Mysterious Emperor Lineage.

Although that information wasn’t much, it allowed Lin Yuan to confirm that the Mysterious Emperor Lineage was not an extremely heretical force.

In fact, through the ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path, Lin Yuan could also sense the creator of this evolution path had a profoundly weighty and broad nature. Would such a being, so powerful, intentionally set traps for later generations? Such a powerhouse would likely disdain to do so.

Soon.

Lin Yuan arrived in front of Xuan Huang Hall.

At that moment, the palace gave Lin Yuan no sense of oppression; it was just like any ordinary palace.

Standing in front of the palace, the calling Lin Yuan felt was nearly tangible.

“Child, come inside.” It was then that an ancient voice came from within the palace.

Lin Yuan did not hesitate and strode into the palace.

Deep inside the palace, a figure, tens of meters in size, was sitting cross-legged.

“Child, you must have many questions in your heart now.” The gigantic figure was humanoid but had six arms, wrinkled skin, and smiled at Lin Yuan.

“I actually can’t sense the other’s presence at all?” Lin Yuan looked more earnest.

Even an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse wouldn’t give Lin Yuan this impression; at most, they were just someone he couldn’t defeat or contend against.

“Could he be Tier 12?” Lin Yuan regarded the other solemnly. He had met the Xia Qin Supreme Being, but that was in the Virtual World.

As for meeting in real life… he had not once.

“Child, there’s no need to be nervous. Since you cultivated the Emperor’s Evolution Path, you are essentially the Emperor’s Successor, and I will not cause you any harm,” the Six-Armed Silhouette said with a smile.

“The Emperor’s Evolution Path?”

Lin Yuan had anticipated this; the calling he felt originated from the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path he was concurrently cultivating, while the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was related to the legendary ‘Emperor.’

As soon as Lin Yuan learned of the ‘Emperor’ from Stone Statue Shen Ji, he conjectured that the ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path was indeed the Evolution Path ventured by that ‘Emperor.’

“Indeed.”

“Throughout the long years, in many locations within the secret realm, I left the first half of the ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path, but regrettably, to this day, no being has penetrated the first half and entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm…”
